author_role: Independent acceptance reviewer; proposal from existing original Gate purpose, not a retrospective pass amendment

freeze_rule.must_freeze_before: Any new six-configuration 150-image target/output dataset run
freeze_rule.separate_manifest_required: Exact source graph/weights/ranges/module map/build flags/actual precision/float-fusion comparisons and evaluator hashes for all six; runtime arithmetic evidence may be collected in predeclared fixed-input preflight before dataset
freeze_rule.outcome_unknown_scope: New matched native family 150-image target decisions only; this is not fresh independent research preregistration
freeze_rule.no_selective_family_or_parameter_revisio: Preserve first preregistered outcomes. A separately justified subsequent family is a new diagnostic, cannot replace its result.

purpose_and_claim.question: On a fixed real Orin deployment family, does a target hit by native FP16 disappear under verified W8A8 q_all and return for the same target under the predeclared G1 FP16 restoration?
purpose_and_claim.primary_estimand: Existence of one or more target IDs in (F minus Q) intersect R_G1 on this fixed old Holdout
purpose_and_claim.primary_group_basis: Original research route item 9 explicitly names G1; combined G1+G5/G1+G2 are required predeclared secondary summaries, not outcome-selected replacements.
purpose_and_claim.scope: Local deployment migration and phenomenon authenticity, conditional on the tested compiler family and original data
not_claimed: positive net benefit from any nonzero rescue
purpose_and_claim.no_new_effect_size_threshold: No arbitrary 99-percent agreement, minimum rescue-rate or significance threshold is invented to obtain PASS.

protected_history.failure_explanation_status: Same-input quantizers and weight codes matched; small Conv floating differences reach activation rounding boundaries and propagate. Saved localization establishes this mechanism at inspected points, not an exhaustive explanation of every downstream difference.
protected_history.old_guard_is_not_relabelled: A new independent full ONNX reference is a distinct deployment/export contract; no old row becomes PASS and no hybrid counterfactual becomes a reference.
protected_history.old_single_image_and_slices: Evidence reusable for provenance/localization only; not new 150-image performance or recovery evidence.

fixed_data_and_model.order: Exact manifest.data.evaluation order, all images and all label-file SHA identities; no hard/easy subset selection
fixed_data_and_model.legacy_holdout_scope: Previously used Gate0 Holdout; diagnostic reuse only, not independent method confirmation
fixed_data_and_model.fixed_smoke_image: 000020.jpg is the original Selection smoke image, not an added 151st Holdout image and not a substitute for the 150-image run

frozen_calibration_semantics.activation: symmetric per-tensor zero-point0, max(absmax/127,1e-12), narrow codes[-127,127]
frozen_calibration_semantics.weight: symmetric per-output-channel axis0 zero-point0, max(per-channel absmax,1e-12)/127

immutable_across_family: frozen calibration ranges/scales/zero points for the same remaining quantizer
source Conv identity and G1-G8 assignment
source nonquantized arithmetic except authenticated export-preserving rewrite
source image bytes, label bytes and target IDs
preprocessed RGB FP32 input array bytes per image
640 input, batch1, bindings and primary-output interpretation
common device/runtime/build policy declared before results
forbidden_outcome_adaptation: take best of repeated builds or runs
discard images with no detections or inconvenient targets
select one reference or precision contract after outcomes

family_build_and_format_contract.recommended_common_policy: Separate new matched family with runtime precision_constraints NONE; INT8+FP16 permitted for all six including unquantized FP16 control, TF32 false; no OBEY/PREFER; workspace1024MiB, avg_timing_iterations1, FLOAT LINEAR external bindings and detailed inspector. Root must confirm actual successful family rather than assuming q_all success transfers.
family_build_and_format_contract.same_flags_even_if_unused: Do not vary INT8 enablement as an extra factor in FP16 control; absent quantizers/actual types, not the enable flag alone, define each source precision.
family_build_and_format_contract.code_clip_importer_correction: For each remaining activation Q->INT8 Clip->DQ, record exact parser before/after alpha,beta and set to -127,+127; source/CPU equivalence and actual request audit required. Do not bypass weight QDQ as W8A8 repair.
family_build_and_format_contract.parser_requests: Preserve intrinsic parsed precision/output requests; no hidden resets or manual per-layer precision/output setters. Record every layer before/after/build and actual get_flag values, not only requested string.
family_build_and_format_contract.binding: Input images FLOAT LINEAR[1,3,640,640], primary output0 FLOAT LINEAR[1,14,8400]; common PE auxiliary declaration if retained must be identical across family and excluded from target inference.
per_quantized_source_required: unique source-to-native weighted operation mapping or verified in-group fusion accounting
native INT8 activation input provenance and INT8 weight type/count
correct source group, kernel weights/counts, activation quantizer/ranges
authenticated integer arithmetic evidence via unchanged named-tactic route or separately labelled new runtime+SASS route
family_build_and_format_contract.quantized_output_format: Do not require INT8 Conv output: FP16/FP32 output is permitted and must be recorded exactly under the existing audit rule.
family_build_and_format_contract.per_fp16_source_required: Use existing restored-source audit: trace to original unquantized weight and activation, FP16 weights and actual FP16 convolution input/output formats, source weight-count/fusion checks. If compiler does not realize requested FP16 treatment, the intended configuration is ineligible, not scientific no-recovery.
family_build_and_format_contract.cross_group_fusion: Apply original auditor rule; any unassignable mixed-group fusion or missing source identity is an eligibility gap, not omitted from counts.
family_build_and_format_contract.input_extraneous_graph_output_or_policy_: Requires explicit new identity/comparability review before dataset; not silently interchangeable with historical engines.

floating_and_fusion_comparability.goal: Make matched treatment claims honest by documenting shared preparation and actual floating computation; same flags/source alone do not prove identical realized arithmetic.
require_exact_when_applicable: source nonquantized node op/attribute/initializer bytes and primary-output indexing
source weights/bias identities, underlying tensor dimensions and constants
shared input array bytes and preprocessing transformations
source Conv group identities and full source coverage
external bindings/layouts and independent evaluator implementation
same common builder flags/policy/device/software versions/power-mode request
actual_metadata_required_for_all_six: raw detailed inspector layers including LayerType, Name, input/output tensor names/formats/dimensions, weight type/count and any reported compute precision
source-to-native mapping and all fused source members
raw tactic names and tactic IDs when supplied; missing names explicitly reported
nonquantized attention MatMul/Softmax, floating pointwise/activation, decode and shape paths: map relevant source ops to actual realized layers/fusions and record FP16/FP32 differences
all floating boundaries affected by QDQ insertion/removal, dequantization and output casts
floating_and_fusion_comparability.must_match_or_be_bridged: Unchanged nonquantized source operations with available mapping must have the same actual floating dtype/format across the comparison or an explicitly preregistered floating control/precision bridge. If metadata cannot establish this, preserve a comparability gap; do not invent equality from operator names.
not_reasonable_to_require: identical fused layer names or fusion partitions
identical tactics for INT8 and FP16 Conv
identical memory scheduling or summation order
INT8 Conv output matching FP16 Conv output dtype
bit-identical native tensors across different quantization treatments
floating_and_fusion_comparability.quantization_necessary_changes: QDQ propagation, boundary reformat/cast, legal quantization-aware fusion and INT8-vs-FP16 weighted kernels can change as part of the deployed treatment. Record and account for these; forcing identical fusion can remove the intervention itself.

eligibility_labels.MATCHED_SOURCE_AND_FLOAT_METADATA_WITH_Q: Required for primary authenticity eligibility; shared unrelated float path matched or controlled, remaining documented changes belong to quantization/restoration deployment realization.
eligibility_labels.UNCONTROLLED_UNRELATED_FLOAT_PATH_DIFFER: Not eligible for primary authenticity verdict without a prespecified bridge/control; target counts may be descriptive but primary INCONCLUSIVE.
eligibility_labels.STRONG_G1_ONLY_CAUSAL_IDENTIFICATION: NOT_ESTABLISHED by this experiment even when the primary existence result passes.

floating_and_fusion_comparability.conditional_interpretation: A returned target is associated with this audited deployed G1-restoration configuration, including necessary precision/fusion changes. It does not isolate a pure G1 arithmetic effect from every compiler consequence.
floating_and_fusion_comparability.no_post_outcome_control_search: Any additional bridge is declared from source/metadata before new Holdout outputs. After outcomes, classify the missing control as a limitation; do not search until rescue appears.

independent_reference_contract.ORT_role: Complete standalone exported-graph semantic reference, evaluated from original preprocessed image input for each configuration. Not a replacement PASS for the old PyTorch guard and not native arithmetic ground truth.
independent_reference_contract.provider_and_policy_to_bind: CPUExecutionProvider, FLOAT32 input, ORT_DISABLE_ALL, four threads; bind ORT/ONNX versions and graph/hash. These match existing full rewrite diagnostic unless a separately justified common policy is frozen.
independent_reference_contract.complete_reference_for_six: One complete corresponding ONNX graph per native configuration; no native intermediate cache, Conv/SiLU injection, shortened DFL fixture, mixed-backend stitched forward or candidate-dependent target selection.
independent_reference_contract.reuse: Existing fixed000020 full original/code-Clip byte equality and source/static hash proof may be reused for that exact graph/input. It does not supply 150-image outputs, nor automatically prove every new restoration graph.
independent_reference_contract.per_config_semantics: Statically authenticate allowed treatment changes, source weights/bias, frozen scales and group map. Authenticate the rewrite Q+codeClip[-127,127]+DQ versus floatClip+Q+DQ semantics; any sampled existing CPU byte equality remains explicitly input-bounded.
two_distinct_comparisons: original PyTorch FP32/QDQ vs exported ORT: historical simulation/export/backend sensitivity and unchanged failed guard
independent corresponding full ORT vs native TensorRT: deployed precision/backend/computation differences, raw and target-level descriptive reports
independent_reference_contract.no_numeric_tolerance_relaxation: No large all-position atol/rtol is introduced to bless CPU/native differences. Original tolerance check, if repeated descriptively, remains labelled with its original threshold and result; this new contract does not assert raw numeric equivalence.
mandatory_discrepancy_outputs: per image/config output shape/dtype/finite counts, raw hashes, coordinate/class-score max/mean/RMS absolute differences and exact mismatch count
same evaluator native-vs-ORT matched target sets with full gains/losses and marginal IoU/confidence values
native/ORT no-detection images and score/box ranges without censoring
FP32 full source export/ORT baseline vs native FP16 matched-target differences reported separately; backend and precision are confounded unless a native FP32 control exists

technical_ineligible: wrong tensor indexing/layout/dtype/shape or box coordinate transform
unauthenticated source/weight/range or incorrect Clip/importer semantics
independent full reference missing/corrupt or input provenance mismatch
proven implementation contract violation or unexplained nonquantized-path mismatch that prevents intended treatment identification
not_automatically_ineligible: finite quantized result having fewer detections
numeric_validity_rules.interpretation: Do not turn an unfavorable valid quantized outcome into an engineering exclusion. Conversely, a documented implementation/mapping mismatch cannot be declared scientific failure of recovery or numerical PASS.
numeric_validity_rules.gross_collapse: Always report full score/box and per-target discrepancy diagnostics. If contract integrity is established and no technical violation is found under the frozen checks, collapse is a valid unfavorable deployed result; if its cause prevents identifying the promised W8A8/FP16 treatment, primary INCONCLUSIVE with exact unresolved evidence. No ad hoc output threshold or error-tolerance increase.

independent_reference_contract.original_PyTorch_FP32_role: If same 150-image source-FP32 results exist with exact hashes/settings, reuse and label as historical. Otherwise bind a separate complete source-FP32 reference before execution. Do not mix its hit denominator into native F-minus-Q; no seventh native engine is silently added.
independent_reference_contract.reference_output_count_recommendation: Six full ORT graphs x150 images=900 complete reference forwards; exact already authenticated saved outputs may be reused per matching identity. Bind budgets before freeze; no run is triggered by this draft.

integer_arithmetic_evidence.old_branch: Original named integer tactic regex/proxy audit and its prior missing-seven statuses remain immutable.
integer_arithmetic_evidence.accept_either_branch_per_actual_quantize: Original verified integer tactic metadata OR the separately labelled authenticated runtime/SASS chain; do not rewrite old tactic result to named-tactic PASS.
runtime_SASS_chain_required: source Conv mapping to actual weighted layer with INT8 input/weights and correct source/group/weight counts
NVTX source/operation interval and exact CUDA API/kernel correlation from the same profiled process/run, with attribution not ambiguous under fusion
device identity and compute capability SM87 for that run
same-process /proc maps or equivalent loaded CUDA module identity plus exact library/cubin bytes/hash; path existence alone insufficient
exact mangled launched kernel symbol -> selected SM87 SASS body from that authenticated binary
signed8 dot/MAC operand provenance and integer accumulation for the weighted operation, distinguishing address IMAD and postprocessing FFMA; actual assembly and dataflow rationale retained
integer_arithmetic_evidence.static43_review_use: Existing four exact libnvinfer SM87 function bodies have IDP.4A.S8.S8 and integer-result conversion chains. This proves those static bodies contain signed integer dot arithmetic, not that the new engine ran them.
not_required_or_claimed: Tensor Core execution solely from a function name
per-instruction hardware trace as a blanket requirement
integer_arithmetic_evidence.branch_ambiguity: A runtime symbol that cannot be tied to the actual weighted source computation, loaded binary or relevant signed-MAC path stays UNVERIFIED/INCONCLUSIVE; never use unrelated library instruction hits.
integer_arithmetic_evidence.restored_FP16_evidence: Actual restored-source format/mapping audit; do not demand integer arithmetic for a source intentionally restored to FP16.
integer_arithmetic_evidence.coverage: Apply to every required quantized source/actual fused weighted operation in each of the five quantized configurations; same authenticated operation/binary body may be reused only with each configuration runtime identity/correlation proved.

input.letterbox: cv2.INTER_LINEAR; ratio=min(640/h,640/w); new dimensions=round; pad114; left/top=round(halfpad-0.1), right/bottom=round(halfpad+0.1)
input.per_image_input_hash: One frozen preprocessed tensor reused byte-for-byte for all native and ORT configurations

NMS.implementation_and_version_sha256: MUST_BIND_BEFORE_FREEZE; use the existing Ultralytics implementation and same backend/device for all native/ORT outputs
NMS.time_limit_behavior: Existing max_time_img2.0 semantics must be recorded. Any truncation/time-limit warning yields incomplete image/INCONCLUSIVE, not silently accepted fewer boxes.
NMS.ties: Freeze candidate order and NMS runtime/device/version; preserve raw output and detection order. Cross-backend NMS tie differences must not be hidden as model differences.

common_input_postprocess_and_matching.smoke_threshold_warning: The original smoke used candidate confidence0.25; the fixed dataset uses original Gate0 diagnostic candidate0.001 followed by primary0.25. They are different scopes, not an adaptive threshold change.
common_input_postprocess_and_matching.coordinate_transform: Subtract exact letterbox left/top, divide by recorded ratio, clip to original image width/height. Match in original pixel coordinates.
common_input_postprocess_and_matching.target_id: image_file_name + colon + original zero-based physical label-line index, as src/gate0.py:238; never renumber by successful match or new annotation parsing
common_input_postprocess_and_matching.target_inventory: All865 target IDs exactly once per configuration; original label bytes and manifest counts. Parse/count inconsistency is engineering incomplete, no target omission.

match.algorithm: enumerate all eligible GT/detection pairs; tuples(IoU,confidence,gt_index,detection_index); sort reverse=True; greedily assign one detection and one GT once
match.decision_precision: Use unrounded floats; CSV rounding only presentation

common_input_postprocess_and_matching.no_reassociation: One fixed target ID defines damage and rescue; a nearby different object or class cannot count as the same target.

sets.A: F minus Q; native quantization-associated added misses
sets.S: F intersect Q; stable native baseline hits

per_recovery_group.rescue_rate: |rescued|/|A| only if |A|>0, otherwise null plus reason
per_recovery_group.collateral_rate: |collateral|/|S| only if |S|>0, otherwise null plus reason
per_recovery_group.outside_F: R_group minus F reported separately, never pooled into A-rescue

auxiliary_G1.overlap_count: number of identical target IDs in dual_overlap
auxiliary_G1.overlap_rate: |dual_overlap|/|A| if |A|>0; also report all component denominators and conditional overlaps
auxiliary_G1.weak_positive: At least one dual_overlap target with all six eligible: weak same-target bidirectional pattern for this deployed family
auxiliary_G1.weak_negative: No dual_overlap on this set: no positive bidirectional pattern here; does not refute G1 causal relevance generally
auxiliary_G1.not_identified: Uncontrolled compiler/fusion consequences or G1 correlations prevent pure-G1 causal attribution in either direction; q_only G1 does not test q_only G1+G5.

target_sets_and_metrics.mandatory_strata: Class and existing Gate0 area-ratio/small-object definition only if exact pre-existing thresholds are pinned; otherwise continuous area or predeclared bins as descriptive. No outcome-selected subgroups.
target_sets_and_metrics.all_targets_recorded: Six matched bits, all rescue/collateral/overlap bits, reference matched bits and supporting detection IDs/IoU/confidence, including negatives.
target_sets_and_metrics.no_robustness_inference: One or more recovered targets establishes local existence only; no repeated-random-sample, multiple-seed, independent-confirmation or population effect claim.

eligibility_and_decision.engineering_eligibility_E: Frozen identity+reference+float/fusion comparability+actual source formats/integer evidence+complete150x6 raw/detection/865x6 target records+saved evidence/cleanup chain all satisfied.

primary_ordered_rules.meaning: Mechanism/existence is not scientifically tested to the promised contract; list exact gap. Cannot claim Gate complete/pass merely because a diagnostic/checkpoint finished.
No usable native baseline hit universe on this data. Report full outcome and investigate; no recovery denominator.
Quantization-associated disappearance was not observed on this fixed diagnostic set. Not a claim that quantization cannot cause misses elsewhere.

primary_ordered_rules.if: E true and |A|>0 and |A intersect R_G1|=0
primary_ordered_rules.meaning: Primary G1 recovery not observed. Report combined-group recoveries without substituting them for primary success.
At least one exact native FP16-hit target disappeared under verified q_all and returned under G1 restoration. This is deliberately narrow existence, not overall accuracy or net benefit.

eligibility_and_decision.collateral_does_not_disappear_on_PASS: Always report collateral/net/retention. A nonzero rescue with negative net is still narrow existence PASS but explicitly NO_NET_RECOVERY_BENEFIT; cannot write beneficial mixed precision or superior deployment.
eligibility_and_decision.combined_groups: Complete independent tables for G1+G5 and G1+G2 on the same A/S denominators; not outcome-selected winner, no monotonic-rescue assumption.
eligibility_and_decision.auxiliary_status_separate: q_only_G1 is predeclared and must be completed for this six-config contract. Its dual-overlap result supplements, not redefines, primary existence PASS/FAIL. If only five core configurations are technically complete, report provisional core verdict plus overall contract incomplete; no bidirectional statement.
eligibility_and_decision.completion_vs_success: A technically valid scientific FAIL can finish the Gate0.5 authenticity investigation with a negative result. It is not permission to enter Gate1 on a positive-mechanism premise. Engineering INCONCLUSIVE is incomplete work, not scientific failure or success.
eligibility_and_decision.preserve_raw_numeric_guard_status: Every final verdict must also show original_complete_model_guard=FAILED_UNCHANGED and new_reference_role=independent_export_semantics; never collapse these into a single PASS.
root_review_policy_decisions: Confirm original item9 primary G1 reading, rather than any-of-three winner selection.
Confirm A=0 is a valid-set nonreproduction FAIL and F=0 is lack-of-baseline INCONCLUSIVE; do not choose after outcomes.
Confirm negative net can only support narrow existence PASS and never benefit.
Confirm all six are planned mandatory deliverables while dual-overlap is auxiliary to the core existence verdict.

planned_execution_and_stop_rules.native_primary_dataset_forwards: 6 configurations x150 images=900 primary scored image forwards, no execution authorized here. Bind exact batching/order/warmup and process budgets in final execution protocol.
planned_execution_and_stop_rules.ordering: All six configurations and full list order fixed before outputs. Each image uses common input. Record run order and environmental state; no best-run choice.
planned_execution_and_stop_rules.repeat_policy: No best-of-N or output-driven rerun. Any prespecified repeat check has its own explicit budget and all outputs preserved; cannot substitute a more favorable copy.
stop_on_technical_issue: unexpected source precision/mapping or library identity
planned_execution_and_stop_rules.scientific_unfavorable_is_not_stop: Zero detections, no added misses, no rescue or collateral loss do not trigger tuning or alternative image/module selection.
planned_execution_and_stop_rules.interruption: Preserve partial raw/receipt and exact progress; final verdict remains INCONCLUSIVE until a separately authenticated continuation completes the original inventory without changing engines/criteria. Do not silently rerun failed build or overwrite outputs.
planned_execution_and_stop_rules.environment: Same Orin/software/power-mode request, fan active, boot/process IDs, memory/temperature logging, private process monitor/guard and cleanup. Preserve board clock discrepancy and nonprivileged EMC query warning.
planned_execution_and_stop_rules.no_performance_claim: Timing during guarded diagnostics is operational only; Gate2 latency/energy measurement is separate.

required_reviewable_outputs: Frozen acceptance contract and execution protocol hash before new150-image outputs
Six-configuration artifact/engine/source/actual-format/floating-comparability eligibility matrix with all88 source identities
Independent complete full-ORT reference provenance and raw outputs for the exact common inputs
Authentic runtime SASS/tactic arithmetic branch evidence and exact dependency identities
Native raw outputs/detections/transforms per image/config; all reference and source FP32 comparison results with limitations
One master target CSV, 865rows with six native hit columns plus reference fields; optionally long form5190rows, both derive the same fixed IDs
Per-config/per-group added-miss/rescue/collateral/net/retention/weak-dual sets with denominators, including empty sets
A deterministic full case index; if visual cases displayed, include every recovered/collateral target or fixed target-ID ordering rather than favorable selection
Exact saved receipt/archive hashes, process completion/cleanup and independent saved-data audit
Final report with separate engineering eligibility, scientific verdict, old guard status, numeric discrepancies and narrow claim limits
unbound_prerequisites_before_freeze: Bind all six actually eligible engines/build/control/reference graphs; only the new q_all build is currently reported successful, not yet independently audited in this draft.
Define and audit exact actual floating-path comparison matrix; resolve unrelated differences before claiming matched recovery.
Freeze concrete full-reference/evaluator/NMS versions and input/detection/target data schemas and run budgets.
Complete same-process maps + exact correlated runtime kernels + authenticated SM87 SASS supplement or named tactic evidence for each quantized source.
Root approve the explicit ordered PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE draft rules, then produce a separate immutable frozen contract before new150-image evaluation.

original_gate_remaining.excerpt:
## 尚未完成的 Gate 0.5 工作

当前仅完成首个精度配置的构建、精度核查和单图执行。64 张原校准图片、150 张原 Holdout 图片及 865 个目标已准备在 `artifacts/gate05/data_v1/`，校准和评估图片内容重叠为 0；本轮未执行这批图片的评估。旧 Holdout 仅用于部署迁移诊断，不能重新包装成新方法的独立确认集。

后续依次完成：

1. 在查看数据集结果前冻结通过、失败和证据不足的判据；沿用固定模型、校准清单、图片清单和目标匹配口径。
2. 构建并检查全 INT8 卷积基线；确认真实 INT8 内核和 G1–G8 映射，不只检查构建开关。
3. 分别构建 G1、G1+G5、G1+G2 保持 FP16 的恢复配置，逐个报告结果。
4. 五个 engine 在同一固定图片集上完成逐目标匹配，统计相对本机 FP16 的新增漏检、同目标救回及附带漏检，并单独检查 FP32→FP16 的变化。

上述五种配置只验证恢复。若声称真实 TensorRT 的双向归因，仍需额外的 `q_only:G1` 破坏侧实验。此轮不作 INT8 真实性、混合精度恢复、正式延迟或能耗结论。

original_quant_scheme.excerpt:
本轮仅检查 `q_all`：全部纳入 G1–G8 的 88 个卷积，其权重和输入激活采用显式 INT8 Q/DQ。其他网络算子允许 FP16/FP32，不能将其描述为全网络所有运算均为 INT8。本轮不运行固定 150 张图片的评估，也不运行 G1/G1+G5/G1+G2 恢复配置。

沿用 Gate 0 的模型、64 张训练校准图片产生的冻结范围和 88 层分组。没有重新校准或依据本轮结果更换图片、模块、范围。量化图来源为上一轮 FP16 使用的同一份 FP32 ONNX，输入 `[1,3,640,640]`，输出 `[1,14,8400]`。

量化设置：

- 激活为对称、逐张量、零点 0，scale=`max(冻结absmax/127,1e-12)`。
- 激活在进入 INT8 QuantizeLinear 前先 Clip 到 `[-127*scale,127*scale]`，保持原模拟的窄范围语义。
- 卷积权重为对称、逐输出通道，axis=0，scale=`max(逐通道absmax,1e-12)/127`，零点 0。
- 不额外量化卷积输出；后续卷积输入按其自身冻结范围量化。
- 显式 Q/DQ 的输入量化位置参考 [TensorRT 开发者指南](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt/archives/tensorrt-861/developer-guide/index.html)和 [NVIDIA 维护者对卷积输入/输出精度的说明](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT/issues/2383)。实际是否采用 INT8 内核仍由引擎逐层证据决定。

research_route.interpretation: Original Gate question; five fixed configurations; G1 recovery as primary existence check; optional q_only G1 for bidirectional overlap; no outcome-based substitution.
